name: File attach flow
oneLiner: on warm paper, a white glass chat panel and a second panel (a memory or library) float in 3D; a real document with the brand's page on it arcs in and drops into the composer as an attachment chip, its bar fills to a green check, it sends up as a bubble, then a dotted link carries it across into the second panel where it lands with Saved, or hits a red wall and stops
say: when the speaker hands an AI a file and says where it goes ('you attach the report, and it lands in its memory' or 'it never leaves the chat'): the file drops in on 'attach', the link reaches the second panel as they name it. mode saved (lands with a green check) or blocked (a red wall stops it)
